senses.gloss: स-जनामात्य स-जनामात्य, i. e. -जन-अमात्य, adj. together with people and ministers, Chr. 53, 25.
सज्ज- + कर्मन् सज्ज- + कर्मन्, n. preparation.
स- + जम्बाल स- + जम्बाल, adj. Muddy.
स- + जल स- + जल, adj. humid, Megh. 23.
स- + जाति स- + जाति, adj. being of the same class, Man. 9, 87.
स- + जातीय स- + जातीय, adj. 1. of the same tribe. 2. of the same species. 3. like.
स- + जिष्णु स- + जिष्णु, adj. with Arjuna.
सज्य स-ज्य (see ज्या), adj. Strung (as a bow), Johns. Sel. 39, 31.

स- + ज्योतिस् स- + ज्योतिस्, adj., n. the time during which the sun or the stars give light, Man. 5, 82 (viz., when a king dies at day-time the impurity lasts till sunset, when he dies at night till the disappearance of the stars).

सजुस् सजुस्, i. e. स-जुष्,
 I. adj. sbst. Associated, a companion.
 II. सजूस्, adv. With, together with (with the instr.).
† 2. सज्ज् सज्ज्, सञ्च् सञ्च् (सञ्ज् सञ्ज्), i. 1, Par. To go, to move.

सज्ज 1. सज्ज् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Armed.
 2. Fortified.
 3. Got ready, Chr. 30, 3; 31, 18; prepared, Pañc. ii. d. 200 (cf. my transl.).
 4. Ornamented.
 5. [] Dressed.
 II. f. जा.
 1. Armour.
 2. Dress.
सज्जता सज्ज + ता, f. Readiness, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 3.

सज्जन सज्जन, i. e.
 A. सन्त् (vb. 1. अस्), -जन, adj.
 1. Respectable.
 2. Good, virtuous, Bhartṛ. 2, 46; 50.
 B. 1. सज्ज् + अन,
 I. (m., f. ना), n.
 1. Fastening, Man. 2, 63.
 2. Arming.
 3. Dressing.
 4. Preparing.
 II. n.
 1. A guard.
 2. A ferry.
 III. f. ना, Caparisoning an elephant, Govardh. Āryā Sapt. 370, d.

सज्जित सज्जित, i. e. सज्ज + इत, adj.
 1. Prepared, Pañc. i. d. 173; 197, 25.
 2. Armed.
 3. Dressed, ornamented.
साजात्य साजात्य, i. e. स-जाति + य, n. Community of genus, Bhāṣāp. 166.
